_meta.what: Pre-edit plan_design_system foundation output pinned for BAR-2 before/after (S5). Captured from the legacy base-system-match leg (plan_design_system.py:217-266) BEFORE the retrofit onto the shared Shape-C engine over a SECOND design_systems signal index. The leg scored keyword overlap against system.get('keywords') — a field 0/54 systems carry — so the +2 overlap term never fired; the only non-zero terms were a full brand-name substring (54/54 names are multi-word, e.g. 'Material Design 3 (Material You)') or a bare category taxonomy word ('system'/'layout') appearing verbatim in the product prose. On realistic problem-language product descriptions best_score stayed 0 -> ALWAYS 'custom', a SILENT husk with no reason and no retrieval envelope.
